sources.title: openbmb/MiniCPM5-1B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Overview MiniCPM5-1B is the first checkpoint in OpenBMB's MiniCPM5 series — a dense 1B model built for on-device and resource-constrained deployment, reaching 1B-class open-source SOTA on agentic tool use, code generation, and difficult reasoning.

sources.snippet: Highlights We are releasing MiniCPM5-1B, the first model in the MiniCPM5 series. It is a dense 1B Transformer built for on-device, local deployment, and resource-constrained scenarios, reaching 1B-class open-source SOTA.
